proc ::mem_ss_pkg::ip_msa::declare {} {
   set ip_dir "$::env(QUARTUS_ROOTDIR)/../ip/altera/subsystems/mem_ss_pkg/ip_msa"
   load_strings "${ip_dir}/strings/module.properties"
   load_strings "${ip_dir}/strings/gui.properties"
   load_strings "${ip_dir}/strings/interfaces.properties"
   load_strings "${ip_dir}/strings/parameters.properties"

   declare_module
   declare_filesets
   declare_display_items
   declare_parameters
   declare_interfaces
}

proc ::mem_ss_pkg::ip_msa::declare_module {} {
   table create module [list \
      [list @           VERSION  OUTDATED_IP_FILE  INTERNAL SUPPORTED_DEVICE_FAMILIES  SUPPORTED_DIE_TYPES  EDITABLE   INSTANTIATE_IN_SYSTEM_MODULE  REPORT_HIERARCHY  OPAQUE_ADDRESS_MAP VALIDATION_CALLBACK            ELABORATION_CALLBACK             DOC_LINKS                   ] \
      [list mem_ss_msa  1.0.5    mem_ss_msa.odip   true     NOVAL                      NOVAL                true       true                          true              false              ::mem_ss_pkg::ip_msa::validate ::mem_ss_pkg::ip_msa::elaborate  {USER_GUIDE SUPPORT_CENTER} ] \
   ]
}

proc ::mem_ss_pkg::ip_msa::declare_filesets {} {
   table create filesets [list \
      [list @              KIND           TOP_LEVEL      CALLBACK                                             ] \
      [list sim_vhdl       sim_vhdl       mem_ss_msa_top ::mem_ss_pkg::ip_msa::sim_vhdl_fileset_callback      ] \
      [list sim_verilog    sim_verilog    mem_ss_msa_top ::mem_ss_pkg::ip_msa::sim_verilog_fileset_callback   ] \
      [list quartus_synth  quartus_synth  mem_ss_msa_top ::mem_ss_pkg::ip_msa::quartus_synth_fileset_callback ] \
      [list cdc            cdc            mem_ss_msa_top ::mem_ss_pkg::ip_msa::cdc_fileset_callback           ] \
      [list cdc_vhdl       cdc_vhdl       mem_ss_msa_top ::mem_ss_pkg::ip_msa::cdc_vhdl_fileset_callback      ] \
   ]
}

PORT_m_avmm_ready_DESC = Deasserted by the responder when it is unable to respond to a read or write request

The host bit <n> of byteenable indicates whether byte <n> is being written to. During writes, byteenables specify which bytes to write. Other bytes are ignored by the responder.

PORT_m_avmm_readdatavalid_DESC = Asserted by the responder to indicate that the readdata signal contains valid data in response to a previous read request

# Perf opts
#####################################

PARAM_AUTO_PRECHARGE_NAME = Auto-Precharge mode
PARAM_AUTO_PRECHARGE_DESC = Asserting Auto-Precharge on a read or write command instructs the memory controller to automatically close the currently opened row, thereby speeding up a subsequent access to a different row.

   RANGE_AUTO_PRECHARGE_DISABLED_NAME = Disabled
   RANGE_AUTO_PRECHARGE_DISABLED_DESC = Auto-precharge will not be issued

   RANGE_AUTO_PRECHARGE_SS_CONTROLLED_NAME = Issued by MSA
   RANGE_AUTO_PRECHARGE_SS_CONTROLLED_DESC = Memory-Specific Adapter (MSA) tracks opened rows to detect row changes and issue auto-precharge

   RANGE_AUTO_PRECHARGE_USER_CONTROLLED_NAME = Issued by user
   RANGE_AUTO_PRECHARGE_USER_CONTROLLED_DESC = User can assert auto-precharge for read or write commands

PARAM_NUM_COPIES_NAME = Number of copies
PARAM_NUM_COPIES_DESC = Memory is partitioned into replicas that contain identical data. This boosts read throughput but reduces write throughput and reduces available storage capacity.

   RANGE_NUM_COPIES_1_NAME = No copies

PARAM_NUM_BANK_FIFOS_NAME = Number of bank FIFOs
PARAM_NUM_BANK_FIFOS_DESC = Bank FIFOs reorder user traffic to uniformly distribute memory accesses across banks to improve read and write throughput. Using distinct AXI IDs for every AXI transaction improves the effectiveness of this feature.

   RANGE_NUM_BANK_FIFOS_0_NAME = No bank spreading

PARAM_SCHEDULER_NUM_READ_NAME = Schedule read opportunities
PARAM_SCHEDULER_NUM_READ_DESC = Number of reads to issue before issuing writes. Starvation is avoided by issuing writes if sufficient read commands are not available.

PARAM_SCHEDULER_NUM_WRITE_NAME = Schedule write opportunities
PARAM_SCHEDULER_NUM_WRITE_DESC = Number of writes to issue before issuing reads. Starvation is avoided by issuing reads if sufficient write commands are not available.

# RANGE_SCHEDULER_POLICY_CLK_WINDOW_NAME = Clock-based window
